Loss report: argo -> drone
[lost] pipeline/.shared display.name (the Drone pipeline name is its id; the display name is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/ci display.name (the Drone pipeline name is its id; the display name is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/ci/trigger/0 ext.passthrough (Ext of provider argo (dependency, eventSource, sensor, trigger) is not written to the Drone file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[emulated] pipeline/.shared/job/run job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/ci project.multi_pipeline: each pipeline is a document named <pipeline>-<job> (each document carries its pipeline's trigger condition)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
